name: AscalonRelationshipTypes
description: Canonical relationship types governing ShortForge / FactoryOS control and pipeline topology

SUPERVISES.description: Entity directs and monitors the operational lifecycle of the target

AUTHORIZES.description: Entity possesses capability or policy authority to grant execution rights

GOVERNS.description: Entity enforces policy, invariant rules, and cryptographic boundaries

REPAIRS.description: Entity diagnoses and executes state restoration or retry actions on target

TERMINATES.description: Entity forcefully revokes leases, kills processes, or aborts missions

EXECUTES.description: Entity performs the concrete computational work of the floor/task

PRODUCES.description: Floor or tool generates the specified data artifact or contract payload

CONSUMES.description: Floor or tool requires the specified data artifact as input

DEPENDS_ON.description: Pipeline floor execution depends on predecessor floor output completion

ESCALATES_TO.description: Anomalies or unresolvable ambiguities bubble up to the target authority

REPORTS_TO.description: Operational telemetry and task completion receipts flow to the target

VERIFIES.description: Entity tests physical properties, cryptographic signatures, or policy criteria

STORES_IN.description: Entity commits immutable bytes or records into the target storage system

ROUTES_TO.description: Router or fabric selects target execution provider or worker node
